name: The Gedeo Cultural Landscape
description: On the eastern edge of Ethiopia's Great Rift Valley, steep highland slopes rise from about 1,300 to over 3,000 metres. They are farmed by the Gedeo people in layers: tall trees shade enset, a staple food plant, and coffee grows beneath. Patches of sacred forest used for rituals survive among the fields, and clusters of ancient standing stones line the ridges, tended by community elders.
